items.question: What percentage of pensionable salary does the insured employee pay as monthly contribution under the UAE federal pension law 2023 (Federal Decree Law No. 57 of 2023)?
items.gold: The insured employee pays 11 per cent of the pensionable salary.
items.fact: Employee pays 11 percent of pensionable salary monthly under 2023 law

items.question: What is the maximum age an Emirati employee can be at appointment and still be registered for pension contributions under the GPSSA federal pension scheme?
items.gold: An employee must not be more than 60 years old to be registered.
items.fact: Emirati employee registration requires age not exceeding 60 years
